angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 507,165 km at 82.62 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 12.1043 +/- 0.0123 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91): 82.62 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.729 +/- 0.029 solar radii from Sanz-Forcada et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2093 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...703A..93S/abstract): 507,165 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.745 +/- 0.034 solar masses from Sanz-Forcada et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2093 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...703A..93S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4426 +/- 85 K from Sanz-Forcada et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2093 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...703A..93S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Sanz-Forcada et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2093 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...703A..93S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2093.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.585, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2093 (pscomppars): spectral type K5 V, from Sanz-Forcada et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...703A..93S/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-2093: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2093 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.08 dex, from Sanz-Forcada et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...703A..93S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2093 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.73565, from Sanz-Forcada et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...703A..93S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2093 (pscomppars): age 6.6 Gyr, from Sanz-Forcada et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...703A..93S/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2093 (pscomppars): rotation period 43.8 d, from Sanz-Forcada et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...703A..93S/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2093 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Sanz-Forcada et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...703A..93S/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
